findings.core.global_staff_role.enabled_without_r: The global staff role is turned on, but no role is selected, so new tickets ping nobody.
findings.core.global_staff_role.invalid: The saved global staff role isn't a valid role. Pick it again in `/bot-setup`.
findings.core.global_staff_role.missing: The global staff role (`{roleId}`) no longer exists on this server.
findings.core.global_staff_role.format_legacy: The global staff role <@&{roleId}> is saved in the old mention format. It can be converted to the plain role ID.
findings.core.global_staff_role.not_mentionable: The global staff role <@&{roleId}> can't be mentioned and the bot lacks **Mention @everyone, @here, and All Roles**, so new-ticket pings don't notify staff. Make the role mentionable or grant the bot that permission.
findings.core.global_staff_role.error: Couldn't check the global staff role. Try again later.
findings.core.locale.unsupported: The server language is set to `{locale}`, which the bot doesn't support, so English is used.
findings.core.locale.error: Couldn't check the server language. Try again later.
findings.core.staff_role.unknown_type: A saved role has the unknown type `{type}` (expected `staff` or `admin`). Applications and admin-only tickets ignore it, but it still gets access to new ticket channels.
findings.core.staff_role.invalid: The saved role "{alias}" isn't a valid role reference, so the bot ignores it. The entry can be removed; add the role again with `/role add` if you still need it.
findings.core.staff_role.duplicate: The role <@&{roleId}> is saved twice (it's also entry #{keptRowId}, "{keptAlias}"). The extra entry "{alias}" can be removed.
findings.core.staff_role.missing: The saved role "{alias}" (`{roleId}`) was deleted. The entry can be removed.
findings.core.staff_role.format_legacy: The saved role <@&{roleId}> is stored in the old mention format. It can be converted to the plain role ID.
findings.core.staff_role.error: Couldn't check the saved staff roles. Try again later.

findings.core.guild_permission.unknown_level: A permission grant for **{feature}** uses the unknown level `{level}`, so the bot ignores it.
findings.core.guild_permission.everyone: The @everyone role has **{level}** access to **{feature}**, so every member has it. Remove the grant unless that's intended.
findings.core.guild_permission.missing_role: A permission grant for **{feature}** points to a deleted role (`{roleId}`).
findings.core.guild_permission.error: Couldn't check the feature permissions. Try again later.

findings.memory.forum.duplicate: The memory forum <#{channelId}> is set up twice ("{name}" and entry #{keptRowId}). The extra entry can be removed.

findings.memory.tag.orphan: The memory tag "{name}" belongs to a memory channel that no longer exists. It can be removed.
findings.memory.tag.invalid_type: The memory tag "{name}" has the unknown type `{tagType}`, so it's never offered as a category or a status. It can be removed and added again as a category or status tag.
findings.memory.tag.not_in_forum: The memory tag "{name}" is missing from its forum, so memories filed under it don't get the tag. It can be added back to the forum.

findings.memory.item.orphan: The memory "{title}" belongs to a memory channel that no longer exists. It can be removed.
findings.memory.item.thread_missing: The post for the memory "{title}" was deleted. The memory can be removed.
findings.memory.item.error: Couldn't check the saved memories. Try again later.
findings.rules.config.channel_missing: The rules channel (`{channelId}`) no longer exists, so members can't accept the rules. Run `/rules-setup setup` again.
findings.rules.config.channel_wrong_type: The rules channel <#{channelId}> isn't a text channel. Run `/rules-setup setup` with a text channel.
findings.rules.config.channel_permissions: The bot is missing {permissions} in the rules channel <#{channelId}>. Without View Channel or Read Message History, reacting to the rules doesn't give the role.
findings.rules.config.message_missing: The rules message in <#{channelId}> was deleted, so members can't accept the rules. It can be posted again.
findings.rules.config.role_missing: The rules role (`{roleId}`) was deleted, so accepting the rules gives nothing. Run `/rules-setup setup` with another role.
findings.rules.config.role_everyone: The rules role is @everyone, which can't be assigned. Run `/rules-setup setup` with another role.
findings.rules.config.role_managed: The rules role <@&{roleId}> is managed by an integration, so the bot can't assign it. Run `/rules-setup setup` with another role.
findings.rules.config.role_too_high: The rules role <@&{roleId}> is at or above the bot's highest role, so the bot can't assign it. Move the bot's role above it.
findings.rules.config.manage_roles: The bot is missing **Manage Roles**, so accepting the rules can't give the role.
findings.rules.config.emoji_invalid: The rules emoji `{emoji}` isn't one a reaction can match. Run `/rules-setup setup` with another emoji.
findings.rules.config.error: Couldn't check the rules setup. Try again later.
findings.reactionRole.menu.channel_missing: The channel (`{channelId}`) of the reaction-role menu "{name}" no longer exists, so the menu is gone. The menu can be removed.
findings.reactionRole.menu.channel_wrong_type: The reaction-role menu "{name}" is in <#{channelId}>, which isn't a text channel.
findings.reactionRole.menu.channel_permissions: The bot is missing {permissions} in <#{channelId}> for the reaction-role menu "{name}". Without View Channel or Read Message History reactions don't give roles; unique mode also needs Manage Messages to take the old reaction off.
findings.reactionRole.menu.message_missing: The message of the reaction-role menu "{name}" in <#{channelId}> was deleted. The menu can be posted again.
findings.reactionRole.menu.mode: The reaction-role menu "{name}" has the unknown mode `{mode}` and works as `normal`. It can be set to `normal`.
findings.reactionRole.menu.no_options: The reaction-role menu "{name}" has no options. Add one with `/reactionrole add`.
findings.reactionRole.menu.too_many_options: The reaction-role menu "{name}" has {count} options, but a message can only hold {max} different reactions, so the rest can't be picked. Move some to another menu.
findings.reactionRole.menu.manage_roles: The bot is missing **Manage Roles**, so reaction-role menus can't give or take roles.
findings.reactionRole.menu.error: Couldn't check the reaction-role menus. Try again later.
findings.reactionRole.option.role_missing: The role (`{roleId}`) for {emoji} in the reaction-role menu "{menu}" was deleted. The option can be removed.
findings.reactionRole.option.role_everyone: The option {emoji} in the reaction-role menu "{menu}" gives @everyone, which can't be assigned. Remove it with `/reactionrole remove`.
findings.reactionRole.option.role_managed: The option {emoji} in the reaction-role menu "{menu}" gives <@&{roleId}>, which is managed by an integration, so the bot can't assign it.
findings.reactionRole.option.role_too_high: The option {emoji} in the reaction-role menu "{menu}" gives <@&{roleId}>, which is at or above the bot's highest role, so the bot can't assign it. Move the bot's role above it.
findings.reactionRole.option.emoji_invalid: The option for <@&{roleId}> in the reaction-role menu "{menu}" has an invalid emoji (`{emoji}`), so nobody can pick it. Remove it with `/reactionrole remove` and add it again.
findings.reactionRole.option.emoji_duplicate: In the reaction-role menu "{menu}", {emoji} and {keptEmoji} are the same emoji, so only one of their roles can be given. Remove one of them.
findings.reactionRole.option.error: Couldn't check the reaction-role options. Try again later.
